API3, API4, API6 and API9 are listed as covered only because the delta cannot reach them. It changes guide text in build.mjs and the generated index.html, with no DTOs, entities, limits, rate limiting, cancel or refund logic, or routes. I checked that nothing in the delta weakens them. This is a vacuous pass, not a code review of those items.

API1, API2 and API5: n/a, auth is out of scope. API7: n/a, no outbound URL fetching. API10: n/a, no upstream APIs. The .NET extras (SQL, money, packages, logging) are n/a because the delta touches no code or packages.
